Shape and linetype scales for colour-blind readers

Source: R/accessibility.R
scale_shape_phw.Rd

Colour should never be the only way to tell groups apart. These scales add a second cue: point shapes that differ in outline as well as fill, and line types that stay distinct in print. Use them on the same variable as the colour, and ggplot2 merges the legends.

Usage

scale_shape_phw(..., values = c(16, 17, 15, 18, 1, 2, 0, 5))

scale_linetype_phw(
  ...,
  values = c("solid", "22", "42", "13", "1343", "73", "2262", "12223242")
)

Arguments

...

Passed to ggplot2::scale_shape_manual() or ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual().

values

Override the shapes or line types.

Value

A ggplot2 scale.

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = drv, shape = drv)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_shape_phw() +
  theme_phw()
